content.title: Chapter 6 - ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES — Sec. 6-63. - Compensation.
content.summary:
The hearing officer shall receive the hourly compensation described in the hearing
               officer's employment contract with the city. If the hearing officer is a salaried
               employee of the city, the hearing officer shall not be paid any additional compensation.
(
Ord. No. 4670
